name: Claude Code Voice Mode
description: Voice mode for Claude Code that allows developers to speak their prompts instead of typing them. Reached #1 Product of the Day on April 2, 2026.
community_quotes: #1 Product on Product Hunt on April 2, 2026
Allows users to speak their prompts into Claude Code

name: ZooClaw
description: A proactive team of AI specialists in one place. Acts as a single entry point to multiple AI agents with structured domain expertise, automatically routing tasks to the right agent with natural language input.
community_quotes: Your proactive team of AI specialists in one place

name: Cursor 3
description: Unified workspace for parallel local/cloud agents and MCPs (Model Context Protocol). A major update to the Cursor AI IDE enhancing it with multi-agent capabilities and parallel execution.
community_quotes: Unified workspace for parallel local/cloud agents and MCPs

name: Viktor
description: An AI coworker that lives in Slack and automates workflows by observing team behavior. Proactively suggests automations and has context from tools and conversations, running autonomously without manual setup.
community_quotes: An AI coworker that actually does the work
Viktor doesn't just wait for you to ask. It observes how your team works and chimes in

name: traceAI
description: Open-source LLM tracing framework designed specifically for GenAI applications. Captures every LLM call, prompt, token count, retrieval step, and agent decision as structured traces.
community_quotes: Open-source LLM tracing that speaks GenAI, not HTTP

name: Baton
description: A desktop app for developing with AI coding agents. Run multiple agents in parallel, each in their own git-isolated workspace. Provides PR-ready code review capabilities with parallel agent execution.
community_quotes: Each agent operates in its own isolated git workspace
